```{r}
reference_scenario = ""
load("1476.RData")

figure_folder <- function(x){
  path = file.path(getwd(),'Plots',
                   x)
  print(path)
  return(path)
}


scen_pub_names_new <- scen_pub_names |>
  mutate(PUBSCEN = case_when(
    PUBSCEN == "Diet -10 NonFed 0 Capture -10" ~ "Barriers to Blue Growth",
    PUBSCEN == "Diet 0 NonFed 0 Capture 0" ~ "BAU",
    PUBSCEN == "Diet +10 NonFed +50 Capture +10" ~ "Blue Transformation",
    PUBSCEN == is.na(PUBSCEN) ~ "FAO",
    TRUE ~ as.character(PUBSCEN)
  ))

raw_scen_names <- c("SCEN_DIET-10_CULTURE0_CAPTURE-10","SCEN_DIET0_CULTURE0_CAPTURE0","SCEN_DIET+10_CULTURE+50_CAPTURE+10")
scen_include <- function(x){
  x %>% filter(ALLSCEN3 %in% raw_scen_names)
}

production_df_detailed <- output_ag_2020 %>% filter(VAR_ID == 'PROD',ITEM_AG %in% c('CRP','LSP',VAR_UNIT == '1000 T')) %>% 
  group_by(ITEM_AG,ALLSCEN3,YEAR) %>% 
  summarise(output = sum(OUTPUT_AG)) %>% 
  rename('TYPE' = 'ITEM_AG') %>% 
  bind_rows(
    fish_var_2020  %>% #  filter(ALLSCEN3 %in% c("SCEN_BAU", "SCEN_DIET_+05"#, "SCEN_CAP_WILD"           )) %>% 
      mutate(Inland = ifelse(as.numeric(FISHREG) < 10 | FISHSYST == "AQUA_F","Inland","Marine") ) %>% ################ FFFFIIIIXXX THIS
      mutate(GROUP = case_when(FISHSPEC %in% c("DMRS","MARN","SALM","TUNA","FRSH","PELG") ~ "Finfish",
                               FISHSPEC %in% c("SHRI","CRST") ~ "Crustaceans",
                               FISHSPEC %in% c("MLSC","CEPH") ~ "Molluscs"),
             TYPE = ifelse(FISHSYST == 'CATCH',"CATCH","CULTURE")) %>%
      group_by(ALLSCEN3, #TYPE, 
               TYPE,FISHFEEDSYST, #Inland,
               YEAR#, GROUP
      ) %>% {products <<- .}  %>% 
      summarise(output = sum(FISH_VAR_COMPARE)) 
  ) 

```


```{r Figure 1: Demand}
live_final <- c("BVMEAT","SGMEAT","PGMEAT","PTMEAT","ALMILK","PTEGGS")
  # tidy_globiom("DemQuantity_Compare") %>% 
DData %>%
  scen_include %>%
  filter(PRODUCT %in% c(fish_final, live_final)) %>%
  mutate(
    product_type = case_when(
      PRODUCT %in% fish_final ~ "Fish",
      PRODUCT %in% live_final ~ "Livestock",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(pWASTE_) %>%
  mutate(ITEMw = ifelse(is.na(ITEMw), 1, ITEMw)) %>%
  mutate(value = case_when(
    product_type == "Fish" ~ DDATA_COMPARE / (1 - ITEMw), ### INVERT BACK TO LIVE WEIGHT FOR FISH ONLY
    TRUE ~ DDATA_COMPARE ### LEAVE LIVESTOCK UNTRANSFORMED
  )) %>%
  group_by(product_type, YEAR, ALLSCEN3) %>%
  filter(CURVE == 'QUANTITY') %>%
  summarise(DData = value %>% sum, .groups = 'drop') %>%
  pivot_longer(DData) %>%
  bind_rows(
    DemQuantity %>%
      scen_include %>%
      filter(PRODUCT %in% c(fish_final, live_final)) %>%
      mutate(
        product_type = case_when(
          PRODUCT %in% fish_final ~ "Fish",
          PRODUCT %in% live_final ~ "Livestock",
          TRUE ~ "Other"
        )
      ) %>%
      left_join(pWASTE_) %>%
      mutate(value = case_when(
        product_type == "Fish" ~ DEMQUANTITY_COMPARE / (1 - ITEMw), ### INVERT BACK TO LIVE WEIGHT FOR FISH ONLY
        TRUE ~ DEMQUANTITY_COMPARE ### LEAVE LIVESTOCK UNTRANSFORMED
      )) %>%
      group_by(product_type, YEAR, ALLSCEN3) %>%
      # filter(CURVE == 'QUANTITY') %>%
      summarise(DemQ = value %>% sum, .groups = 'drop') %>%
      pivot_longer(DemQ)
  ) %>%
  left_join(scen_pub_names_new) %>%
  # mutate(PUBSCEN = factor(PUBSCEN, levels = pub_levels)) %>%
  filter(name == 'DemQ') %>%
  # left_join(fish_pub_names) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = YEAR, y = value / 1000, col = PUBSCEN, group = PUBSCEN)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  # geom_text(aes(label = dem/1000)) +
  ylab("Global Demand (MT)") +
  xlab("Year") +
  # ylim(0,100)+
  theme_classic() +
  facet_wrap(~product_type, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = beyonce_palette(40, type = 'continuous', n = 4)[-1] %>% rev(),
    name = "Scenario"
  )
ggsave(figure_folder('1_demand_lineplot.png'), width = 6, height = 4, unit = 'in')

  # tidy_globiom("DemQuantity_Compare") %>% 
   DData %>% 
  scen_include %>% 
  filter(PRODUCT %in% fish_final) %>% 
    left_join(pWASTE_) %>% 
    mutate(value = DDATA_COMPARE/(1-ITEMw)) %>% ### INVERT BACK TO LIVE WEIGHT
  group_by(REGION,
    YEAR,ALLSCEN3) %>% 
      filter(CURVE == 'QUANTITY') %>% 
  summarise(DData = value %>% sum) %>% 
      pivot_longer(DData) %>% 
      bind_rows(
         DemQuantity %>% 
  scen_include %>% 
  filter(PRODUCT %in% fish_final) %>% 
    left_join(pWASTE_) %>%

  group_by(REGION,
    YEAR,ALLSCEN3) %>% 
    #  filter(CURVE == 'QUANTITY') %>% 
  summarise(DemQ = value %>% sum) %>% 
    pivot_longer(DemQ)
      ) %>% 
     left_join(scen_pub_names_new) %>% 
      #  mutate(PUBSCEN = factor(PUBSCEN, levels = pub_levels)) %>% 
       filter(name == 'DemQ') %>%

  #left_join(fish_pub_names) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = YEAR,y = value/1000, col = PUBSCEN, group = PUBSCEN
  )) +
  geom_line() +

           # geom_text(aes(label = dem/1000)) +

  ylab("Global Demand (MT)") +
  xlab("Year") +
  # ylim(0,100)+
  theme_classic() +
    facet_wrap(~REGION, scales = 'free') +
  scale_color_manual(values = beyonce_palette(40, type = 'continuous', n = 4)[-1] %>% rev(),
                     name = "Scenario") 
  
ggsave(figure_folder('1_demand_lineplot_region.png'), width = 12, height = 8, unit = 'in')
```

```{Demand per Capita}
# Get global population data for ALL scenarios
global_pop <- output %>%
  filter(VAR_ID == "POPT") %>%
  group_by(YEAR, ALLSCEN3) %>%  # Group by scenario too
  summarise(total_pop = sum(OUTPUT, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

# Calculate per capita demand
DData %>%
  scen_include %>%
  filter(PRODUCT %in% c(fish_final, live_final)) %>%
  mutate(
    product_type = case_when(
      PRODUCT %in% fish_final ~ "Fish",
      PRODUCT %in% live_final ~ "Livestock",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(pWASTE_) %>%
  mutate(ITEMw = ifelse(is.na(ITEMw), 1, ITEMw)) %>%
  mutate(value = case_when(
    product_type == "Fish" ~ DDATA_COMPARE / (1 - ITEMw), ### INVERT BACK TO LIVE WEIGHT FOR FISH ONLY
    TRUE ~ DDATA_COMPARE ### LEAVE LIVESTOCK UNTRANSFORMED
  )) %>%
  group_by(product_type, YEAR, ALLSCEN3) %>%
  filter(CURVE == 'QUANTITY') %>%
  summarise(DData = value %>% sum, .groups = 'drop') %>%
  # Add debugging: uncomment to see actual totals BY SCENARIO
  # filter(YEAR == 2030, ALLSCEN3 == "SCEN_DIET-10_CULTURE0_CAPTURE-10") %>% print() %>%
  pivot_longer(DData) %>%
  bind_rows(
    DemQuantity %>%
      scen_include %>%
      filter(PRODUCT %in% c(fish_final, live_final)) %>%
      mutate(
        product_type = case_when(
          PRODUCT %in% fish_final ~ "Fish",
          PRODUCT %in% live_final ~ "Livestock",
          TRUE ~ "Other"
        )
      ) %>%
      left_join(pWASTE_) %>%
      mutate(value = case_when(
        product_type == "Fish" ~ DEMQUANTITY_COMPARE / (1 - ITEMw), ### INVERT BACK TO LIVE WEIGHT FOR FISH ONLY
        TRUE ~ DEMQUANTITY_COMPARE ### LEAVE LIVESTOCK UNTRANSFORMED
      )) %>%
      group_by(product_type, YEAR, ALLSCEN3) %>%
      # filter(CURVE == 'QUANTITY') %>%
      summarise(DemQ = value %>% sum, .groups = 'drop') %>%
      pivot_longer(DemQ)
  ) %>%
  left_join(scen_pub_names_new) %>%
  filter(name == 'DemQ') %>%
  # Join with population data to calculate per capita
  left_join(global_pop, by = c("YEAR", "ALLSCEN3")) %>%  # Join by both YEAR and ALLSCEN3
  # Add debugging output
mutate(per_capita_kg = (value / 1000 / total_pop) * 1000) %>% # Uncomment these lines to debug:
  #glimpse() %>%
  #filter(YEAR == 2030) %>% print() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = YEAR, y = per_capita_kg, col = PUBSCEN, shape = product_type, group = interaction(PUBSCEN, product_type))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  ylab("Per Capita Demand (kg/person)") +
  xlab("Year") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = beyonce_palette(40, type = 'continuous', n = 4)[-1] %>% rev(),
    name = "Scenario"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("Fish" = 16, "Livestock" = 17),
    name = "Product Type"
  )
  ggsave(figure_folder('1_demand_percapita.png'), width = 6, height = 4, unit = 'in')

```

```{r Figure 2 Production Dynamics}
  # summarise(output = sum(output)) %>%

  filter(TYPE %in% c("CULTURE","CATCH"), ALLSCEN3 != "SCEN_REF_2020") %>% 
  mutate(Source = 'This Study') %>% 
    filter(!is.na(PUBSCEN)) %>% 

  bind_rows(data) %>% 
  # mutate(PUBSCEN = factor(PUBSCEN, levels = pub_levels)) %>% 
  filter(ALLSCEN3 %in% raw_scen_names | is.na(ALLSCEN3)) %>%
```

```{r Figure 3. Aquafeed Comparison}
fish_aquafeed_compare %>% 
  group_by(PRODUCT,ALLSCEN3,YEAR) %>% 
  summarise(value = sum(FISH_AQUAFEED_QUANTITY_COMPARE)) %>% 
  left_join(crop_pub_names) %>% 
  left_join(scen_pub_names) %>% 
    mutate(PUBSCEN = factor(PUBSCEN, levels = pub_levels)) %>% 

  ggplot() +
  geom_col(aes(x = YEAR, y = value,fill =PUBFEED)) +
  facet_wrap(~ PUBSCEN, ncol = 3) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 7)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = (beyonce_palette(40) %>% rev)[-4], name = 'Feed Type') +
  ylab("Aquafeed Production (1000 Tons)")

aquafeed_2020 <- fish_aquafeed_compare %>% 
  scen_include() %>% 
  group_by(PRODUCT,ALLSCEN3,YEAR) %>% 
  summarise(value = sum(FISH_AQUAFEED_QUANTITY_COMPARE)) %>% 
  left_join(crop_pub_names) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(YEAR == '2020', ALLSCEN3 == 'SCEN_DIET0_CULTURE0_CAPTURE0') %>% 
  mutate(ALLSCEN3 = 'SCEN_REF_2020')
  
fish_aquafeed_compare %>% 
  scen_include() %>% 
  group_by(PRODUCT,ALLSCEN3,YEAR) %>% 
  summarise(value = sum(FISH_AQUAFEED_QUANTITY_COMPARE)) %>% 
  left_join(crop_pub_names) %>%
  left_join(scen_pub_names) %>% 

  filter(YEAR == '2050') %>%
  bind_rows(aquafeed_2020 %>% left_join(scen_pub_names)) %>% 
  # pivot_wider(names_from = ALLSCEN3, values_from = value) %>% 
  #   mutate(across(starts_with('SCEN'), function(x) x- SCEN_DIET0_CAPTURE0)) %>% 
  # pivot_longer(starts_with('SCEN'),values_to = 'value', names_to = 'ALLSCEN3') %>% 
    left_join(scen_pub_names) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(value), value != 0) %>% 
  group_by(PUBSCEN) %>%
  mutate(tot = sum(value)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(PUBSCEN = fct_reorder(PUBSCEN, tot, .desc = FALSE)) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_col(aes(x = PUBSCEN, y = value,fill =PUBFEED)) +
  # facet_wrap(~ PUBSCEN, ncol = 3) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 7)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = (beyonce_palette(40) %>% rev)[-4], name = 'Feed Type') +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("Aquafeed Production in 2050 (1000 Tons)")# +
```

```{r Figure 4. Impact Figure}
#### Specific Items have been selected...may need to be careful. 
ref_2020 = FALSE
source("scripts/glob.plot.R")
if(ref_2020){
reference_scenario = 'SCEN_REF2020'
input_df <- output_ag %>% 
  scen_include() %>%
  bind_rows(
    output_ag %>% filter(YEAR == 2020) %>%filter(ALLSCEN3 == "SCEN_DIET-10_CULTURE0_CAPTURE-10")%>%
  mutate(ALLSCEN3 = 'SCEN_REF2020',YEAR = as.character(2050))
  )
}else{
  reference_scenario = 'SCEN_DIET0_CULTURE0_CAPTURE0'
  input_df <- output_ag %>% scen_include()
}

pt_land <- glob.plot(scen_baseline = reference_scenario, glob_df = input_df ,var_id = "LAND", 
                     colors_plot = beyonce_palette(40)[c(1,6,7,4,5)],
          title = "a. Land Cover in ", save = TRUE ) 

pt_emis <- glob.plot(scen_baseline = reference_scenario,glob_df = input_df , var_id = "EMIS", save = TRUE,
          title = "b. Emissions in ",
          colors_plot = beyonce_palette(78))

pt_watr <- glob.plot(scen_baseline = reference_scenario,glob_df =input_df , var_id = "WATR", save = TRUE, 
          title = "c. Water Use in ",
          colors_plot = beyonce_palette(2)) 

pt_frtn <- glob.plot(scen_baseline = reference_scenario,glob_df = input_df , var_id = "FRTN", save = TRUE,
          title = "d. Nitrogenous Fertilizer in ",
          colors_plot = beyonce_palette(2)) 

pt_land + pt_emis + pt_watr + pt_frtn
```

```{r}
# Supplement FMFO Assumptions
# Load the necessary library


# Create a data frame for the values
data <- data.frame(
  Year = c(2000, 2010, 2020, 2030, 2040, 2050),
  "Use of Pelagic Fish in FMFO" = c(0.95, 0.8, 0.6, 0.3, 0.2, 0.1),
  "Use of Fish Trimmings in FMFO" = c(0.01, 0.08, 0.10, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6)
)

# Convert the data to a long format for ggplot
library(reshape2)
data_long <- melt(data, id.vars = "Year", 
                  variable.name = "Parameter", 
                  value.name = "Proportion")

# Plot the data
plot <- ggplot(data_long, aes(x = Year, y = Proportion, color = Parameter)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(#title = "Proportions of PELG and WASTE Going to FMFO Over Time",
       x = "Year", 
       y = "Minimum Biomass Use",
       color = "") +
  theme_classic()

# Display the plot
print(plot)
```
